scope: R3.2 phase-0 code selection; pilot probabilities are not the final R3.3 range or the personal p

pilot_conditions.role: rare-event diagnostic, excluded from selection score
high-error diagnostic, excluded from selection score
failure diagnostic, excluded from selection score

gaussian_source: Replay R3.1 personal design bank: (1,3,0,5,g), g=0..4; same frozen filter and quantiser
repeat_choice: 40 independent BSC masks per positive p and layout; about 17.92 million real payload bits per code/p. Rare-event precision is reported honestly and exact error-pattern expectations supplement low counts.
bsc_repeat_mapping: repeat_id=8*gaussian_repeat_id+bit_repeat_id; p=0 uses only bit_repeat_id=0 with no RNG draw
pairing: Identical five Gaussian inputs and 14-bit payload messages across p/codes; different layouts have separate iid BSC masks and unequal transmitted lengths
budget_reason: Declared project resource preference: at most twice the 224 kbit/s source payload; retain a meaningful reliability/cost tradeoff without the fivefold repetition cost. No such link-rate limit is prescribed by the external.
selection_score: For each input bank g, average over four selection p values the ratio of mean coded full-grid MSE over eight masks to the corresponding mean uncoded MSE. Average these five bank scores. Choose the eligible ECC with smallest score below 1.
score_reason: Equal severity weights and normalisation prevent high-error absolute losses dominating; the input-bank grouping respects repeated use of the same Gaussian record.
uncertainty: Pointwise approximate mean +/- t(0.975,4)*sample_sd/sqrt(5) over input-bank scores and paired code-score differences; descriptive phase-0 uncertainty, not held-out validation or simultaneous guarantees
payload_block_error_definition: Wrong decoded real message bits; final partial block excludes padding. Also save full padded-message block failures for the exact Binomial correction-radius comparison.
personal_parameter_leaf_0_1: Unused; p range/mapping/baseline remain null until R3.3
validation: No study-3 phase-1 or study-4 paths; final error-range and coded-success thresholds remain for R3.3/R3.4
